facts.fact: Harrison 进场与单膝跪地：五分钟后
facts.anchor: Five minutes later, Harrison speed-walked into the meeting room and kneeled in front of me

facts.fact: 指检脉搏的触感：茧与轻
facts.anchor: his fingertips gentle despite their calluses
Your heart’s doing jumping jacks. Have you had your water? A snack?

facts.fact: POTS 研究的猜测：他也许查过
facts.anchor: Surely he hadn’t researched POTS treatments. Or maybe he had
Our faces were inches from one another

facts.fact: 他在找的答案：一个没问出口的问题
facts.anchor: like he was searching for the answer to a question he hadn’t asked

facts.fact: Harrison 的严格命令：带回 Greer House
facts.anchor: I’m under strict orders to take you back to Greer House.

facts.fact: damsel in distress 打趣（More or less）
facts.anchor: a damsel in distress needed a big strong man to carry her out of the conference room
I heard her on the phone. She’s behind it all.

facts.fact: tilapia 想象与「不可能单独作案」
facts.anchor: shoveling half-chewed tilapia out of a truck bed. There’s no way she’s working by herself.
ticked slightly higher
We’d returned to our pre-party relationship
I’m not leaving this floor.
you’re about to help me perfect my fireman’s lift

facts.fact: 扛人细节：右手按大腿固定
facts.anchor: His right hand pressed firmly into my thigh
pleasantly, like I was falling asleep
Rivals or not, I felt better with him beside me.

facts.fact: 车停 Greer House 碎石停车场、他盯手机
facts.anchor: we were parked in Greer House’s gravel lot, and Harrison was staring at his phone.
I couldn’t press the button hard enough to release the buckle

facts.fact: 无 Virginia 在家：他抱她回房、放洗澡水
facts.anchor: Without Aunt Virginia at home, it was he who carried me to my room, ran the shower
a hot one would have knocked me right out
I pulled on the T-shirt he’d left out for me

facts.fact: 速写本暴露：手掌几乎盖满一页
facts.anchor: His hand nearly covered an entire page
his forearm flexed as he tapped a finger on its bottom corner
I tried to sound as combative as usual, but my voice came out soft
Too late for me to mind.
hesitating only a moment before sitting on the edge of my bed, lips pressed tightly together
Since I saw them, I might as well tell you—they’re beautiful. The drawings.

facts.fact: 二十多年无人夸她的画
facts.anchor: No one had complimented my artwork in over twenty years

facts.fact: 退学的由来：她 pulled me out of school
facts.anchor: since she’d pulled me out of school
Your drawings make gross things—ugly things—kind of remarkable.
The first few pages.
the tween squashing the beetle beneath her sandal
the possum by the highway, maggots wriggling inside its gaping stomach
Those aren’t…Those are just for me. They’re practice.
You should send them to a gallery.
Maybe they were just a depiction of how things were, not some kind of moral failing.
But maybe take a nap first?
he tucked my quilt around me

facts.fact: 她猜他在决定是否送 urgent care
facts.anchor: Probably whether to take me to urgent care.
“I know.”

facts.fact: 入睡前的担忧清单：噩梦／冷手／影子
facts.anchor: too tired to worry about the nightmares
something soft brushed my cheekbone
His lips.
breath warm on my skin. Then he pushed himself up from the bed and left the room.
It hadn’t been a spur-of-the-moment kiss
He’d thought about it for a few seconds. Longer.

facts.fact: out of time, out of place
facts.anchor: might as well have happened out of time, out of place
I dug my nails into my palms and winced at the subsequent sting.
Nova sounded like she was describing a monster
Nova sounded exactly like Mama talking about me.
